description:
• Brand introduction:

Since 2018, BrownPea Health has been dedicated to providing top-quality nutrition and supplement guides to various communities. Based in New Jersey, our mission is to spread a healthy lifestyle and love through our carefully curated range of vitamins and supplements. We pride ourselves on offering products that are both effective and affordable, ensuring that everyone has access to the nutrients they need to live a healthier life.

 
• Product description:

BrownPea Health offers a wide range of vitamins and supplements designed to support overall health and well-being. Our product line includes essential vitamins, minerals, and specialty supplements that cater to various health needs, such as immune support, heart health, and energy boosting. Each product is formulated with high-quality ingredients to ensure maximum efficacy and safety for our customers.

• USP (Unique Selling Point): 

Our unique selling point is our commitment to quality and transparency. We source only the best ingredients and adhere to strict manufacturing standards to ensure that our products meet the highest quality standards. Additionally, we provide detailed product information and nutrition guides to help our customers make informed decisions about their health.

• Payment terms: 

Affiliates will earn a 5% commission on total referral sales. Commissions are calculated based on the sale amount, excluding shipping and taxes. Payments are made on a monthly basis via PayPal, once the minimum payout threshold of $50 is reached.• Other information:

Additional Terms: Affiliates will receive a 5% commission on all sales generated through their affiliate link or coupon code. There are no limits on the amount you can earn.

Support: Our dedicated affiliate support team is available to assist you with any questions or issues you may have. We provide marketing materials and tips to help you succeed in promoting our products.
